name: HelixScreen
description: A touch screen interface for Klipper, in place of Anycubic's own screen: print files, temperatures, the ACE Pro, the chamber light and more. Needs Klipper (vanilla) or a tunneled Klipper, and takes over the printer's screen while it is enabled. With Klipper (vanilla) there is nothing to set up. With a tunneled Klipper, open this app's settings, set "Moonraker host" to the address of the machine running Klipper, then restart the app. Kobra S1 only for now. By prestonbrown.
